title: Page 129
transc:
Ft Monroe May 15 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di  10.30 AM
for Belcher unity the arrival of Nabobs pontiac at Haxall
increases the number of animals to be shaded by about
female promise zebra in anticipation of some emergency of this
kind I have been forwarding all the shaker I could
spare to Bermuda hundreds and have enough to last plaster
or pledge days zodiac I do not know how long
we shall have to shade these spartans unity pandora Thomas
informed me that Shaker was abundant pekin I therefore request
that our supply be largely increased walrus H. Biggs Vincent
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe May 15th 1864 
R OBrien Hd. Qrs. Gen'l Butler 
In your wreathe of may gallant agnes
you used the wrong route unity Have
corrected it here and sent forward Lucy
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe May 16 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di 
from Deep bottom Bergen may gallant Francis peasant may gift
Harriet for Burton zebra Knox who I hear is oiling
Saco Drury informs one that the walnuts are removing their
obstructions above Drurys bluff unity walpole flag of truce officer
told Lawson yesterday afternoon the walnut ironic lads well fitted
for wallacing would be down in few days zodiac perfume 
Ironic lads here & Canonicus coming from Turkey Sidney bend
pekin Pontiac in fine spirits youth neptune pleasant but unsettled
Geo D Sheldon
